name: cliniccare
description: ClinicCare - Digital Clinic Management System for General Physician

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('client/node_modules/.bin/vite')) cp.execSync('npm install --prefix client',{stdio:'inherit'}); if(!fs.existsSync('server/node_modules/express')) cp.execSync('npm install --prefix server',{stdio:'inherit'}); cp.execSync('npm --prefix client run build',{stdio:'inherit'});"
